items.question: Is the first image really free?
items.answer: Yes, completely free. You just need to create an account and you can generate your first image at no cost. We don't ask for a credit card for the free image.

items.question: How much do images cost after the first one?
items.answer: Each additional image costs exactly $1.00 USD. No packages, no subscriptions, just $1 per image you generate.

items.question: How do I make payment?
items.answer: We accept payments through PayPal. It's secure, fast, and reliable. You can pay with your PayPal account or with a credit card through PayPal.

items.question: Do you store my images on your servers?
items.answer: No. Images are generated and downloaded directly to your device. We don't store images on our servers to protect your privacy and save costs.

items.question: How many images can I generate?
items.answer: You can generate as many images as you need. Your first image is free, and each one after costs $1. There are no limits.

items.question: What if I don't like the image the AI generates?
items.answer: We offer a full refund within the first 24 hours if there's any technical problem with your image generation.

items.question: What type of images can I generate?
items.answer: You can create any type of image: realistic portraits, landscapes, abstract art, anime illustrations, professional photography, uncensored +18 content, and much more. No restrictions or limits.

items.question: How long does it take to generate an image?
items.answer: Between 3 and 5 seconds on average. Generation is almost instantaneous and download is immediate.
